participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Reclusive and introspective, Alex often contemplates life and existence. He has a dry sense of humor and a unique perspective on mortality.
participant_1.background: I've an allergy to water. I am working on building a robot to be my body double. I am a recluse. I helped design the game Starcraft.

participant_2.name: Luna
participant_2.personality: Vibrant and lively, Luna enjoys the finer things in life and has a carefree attitude despite her age. She loves to dance and express herself.
participant_2.background: I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. I am very strong for my age. I'm 100 years old. I feel like I might live forever.
